name: ai.file2markdown/file2markdown
title: file2markdown
description: Convert documents and web pages to clean, LLM-ready Markdown: PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, EPUB, scanned files (OCR), and any public URL.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Pro API key as 'Bearer f2m_...' — removes the daily limit and enables OCR. Free tier works without it.
